title: Unreal Engine projection of ant-hive-world — timelapse 3D rendering of harvested turns on the orwell host
source: operator direction 2026-08-04T21:19Z: 'timelapse is fine but i want it in unreal'
description: Build an Unreal Engine visualization on the orwell host (RTX 5070 Ti) that consumes the harvested, sanitized ant-hive-world projection (world-state, build ledger with spatial coordinates, resource positions, mirror-detector statistics) and renders the hive world in 3D, advancing turn-over-turn in a timelapse cadence driven by short Orwell turns. Strictly a read-only projection consumer: no channel into the sealed VM, no membrane change, no golden change.

overlap_disposition.stated_reason: The owning plan is mid-execution on a high-risk operator-gate lane and scoped to the Orwell deployment/turn contract. This work shares only the harvested-projection DATA surface, none of the mutation surface. Grafting an Unreal build onto a nearly-complete deployment plan would balloon its scope. Interface point (turn cadence + harvest manifest) is bound explicitly in S0.

similarity_assessment.disposition: no credible framework match; gap plan authored from scratch. The prior plan's external_skill_disposition already recorded 'no Unreal or simulation-runtime skill installed' as a known gap.

steps.title: Cadence + projection interface contract
steps.description: Define the short-turn timelapse loop (cadence owned by ant-world-orwell-live-dashboard) and freeze UnrealImport/1.0 DERIVED from the ACTUAL fixture key structure (verified against both fixtures 2026-08-04T23:54Z): world-state.json provides geometry_log (build events: hive, kind, coords, tick, run_id, episode_id, state_at_event), resources {clay,fiber,food,mud,ore,stone,water,wood}, top-level prey_population and predator_population, territory, food_source_coords plus the *_sources maps, seq, complete, written_at, schema_version. There is NO culture or hives key in world-state: the build ledger and mirror statistics are DERIVATIONS the importer computes from geometry_log plus the feature coordinate maps, exactly as tools/ant-hive-world/dashboard.js computes them (same permutation-null). Provenance: turn_id = turn-projection.json run_name; per-turn day span = turn-projection.json ticks (1 tick = 1 simulated day, ratified); absolute_day = cumulative sum of ticks across the import sequence, where the sequence is a PERSISTED append-only index journal (tools/ant-hive-world/unreal-export/import-index.jsonl, one line per turn_id: turn_id, ticks, absolute_day_start, ingested_at, payload_hash) — a turn's absolute_day is fixed at FIRST ingestion and immutable thereafter; re-importing a known turn_id MUST reuse the journaled value and MUST verify the payload_hash matches (mismatch = fail-closed refusal, never silent reassignment); arrival or retry order cannot change previously assigned values. Mirror-statistic derivation is DETERMINISTIC: the importer uses its own seeded PRNG (seed = a stable hash of turn_id), NOT mirror-detector.js's unseeded Math.random, and records the seed and shuffle count in the emitted file so any reviewer can reproduce the p-value byte-for-byte. payload_hash and boundary receipts composed from the host-side manifest chain (RESULT-MANIFEST.txt, HARVEST-MANIFEST.txt, PULL-MANIFEST.txt). turn-projection's mind_state/resume_continuity carried verbatim as advisory metadata. Schema ships with fixture-level validation; the importer must validate the r6 AND r7 fixtures clean before S2 begins.

steps.title: Projection importer
steps.description: Node converter: harvested pull directory -> UnrealImport/1.0 per-turn files. Inputs are the ACTUAL artifacts (world-state.json + turn-projection.json + manifest chain); derivations per S0. Deterministic, schema-validated (fixture tests against the r6 and r7 harvests), idempotent per turn id.

steps.title: Unreal project scaffold on orwell host
steps.description: UE5 project on orwell (RTX 5070 Ti): data-driven level that spawns/updates actors from UnrealImport files — territory tiles, build meshes appearing at their recorded coords, resource markers, a HUD panel for turn id/absolute day/mirror p-value. Turn-advance + auto-advance (timelapse) modes. Uses the ALREADY-INSTALLED UE 5.8 at C:\Program Files\Epic Games (probe-verified 2026-08-04T23:35Z); residual approvals (project dir, watch-service files, version choice) delegated by operator with reversible defaults.

steps.title: Timelapse consumption wiring (importer-only — REVISED per codex review 20260804T212131Z)
steps.description: Unreal consumes ONLY named, immutable post-turn harvest manifests (HARVEST-MANIFEST.txt-verified directories under the staging-out root). A watch on the import directory advances the scene when a new verified turn lands. This plan does NOT invoke run-job, harvest, or CANCEL surfaces — turn/harvest/cancellation orchestration and the short-turn timelapse cadence remain owned by ant-world-orwell-live-dashboard; the cadence parameter is recorded there. Producer contract bound in S0: turn_id, absolute_day, run id, payload hash, and boundary receipt fields are explicit, with provenance receipts checked before a turn is rendered.

steps.description: Evidence: schema-validation receipts for importer output, a recorded multi-turn timelapse session (screen capture or turn-sequence screenshots), zero-NIC/membrane checks unchanged before and after, distinct-family review of the full slice bound to exact commits, run debrief.
